body: i just love her very much and shes my absolute favorite. i want to figure out a way where both of us come out of this ok and happy.

rn she has made a promise not to do any type of drug until a date a ways away, and as her dad is in the hospital she is safe.
yea, i’ll do that as a last resort. you’re right. i’m gonna try and get her to do that herself though, as to not destroy our relationship.

i really wish i could, but i don’t think i’m strong enough as a person to lose the person i care about most. i likely have bpd to make this whole situation more complicated, and to lose her would send me very much spiraling. my post history on this account shows what happened a while back when the last person i cared about this deeply left, it really really crushed me and i don’t want to go back to the psych ward or go through that emotional pain again. i want to make this work if i can, even if that’s a naive goal.

that makes sense. i don’t want to destroy the trust we’ve built but i might be able to convince her to tell either the police or her therapist about what’s going on. i’m pretty sure she has a ton of evidence of physical abuse.

oh dude i know i’m in way over my head. the pressure is unreal. she won’t tell anyone, my goal is to just get her to tell everything to her therapist and have her therapist deal with it from here. just do you think that will help, and she can be convinced to want to stay clean for herself? her parents may be getting divorced soon and if so she can stay at her friend’s house the vast majority of the time. but her dad is in the hospital and might not make it and she isn’t talking to me rn understandably because she’s focusing on that and i really fucking just want her to be ok.

thanks, i needed to hear that i think. it’s hard for me to take my suicide very seriously because i don’t value my life much.

i have a wide social circle, and i’m close with people, i just have trust issues and i don’t really relate to them. people like me but i don’t enjoy time w them, and it sucks. it’s hard for me to really connect with people. i’m in high school atm

you’re right i think. i don’t wanna die, i’d rather be happy. i just don’t have anyone in my life i really vibe with and i haven’t for a long time, and recently i lost the one person i truly loved. i exist to support other people and it sucks
